major_cooldowns.name: Deep Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As Scalecommander send it on cooldown from minimum range and cancel the animation with the /cancelaura macro the moment you reach the target, and in single target delay the second use until Strafing Run is about to expire.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 433874 is the cast id observed in every sampled parse; the guide text references tooltip id 357210, and 357210/1236943 were not observed as casts.

major_cooldowns.name: Dragonrage
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it about every 2 minutes and press Fire Breath and Eternity Surge inside it so Animosity stretches the window toward 32 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Tip the Scales
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it off the global cooldown inside Dragonrage for an instant max rank Eternity Surge, and as Flameshaper never spend it on Fire Breath.

major_cooldowns.name: Eternity Surge
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Empower it to rank 1 and press it on cooldown, but save it for Dragonrage when your Dragonrage window runs under 38 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Fire Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Always empower it to rank 1 and spend its two charges to keep the dot on your targets, refreshing once the dot sits at 30% duration or less.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 357208 is the observed cast id; 357209 is the enemy dot aura and 382266/1283718 were not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Fury of the Aspects
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it when your group calls for the haste window, since it hands everyone Exhaustion for the next 10 minutes.
major_cooldowns.id_note: talent_gated is set so a raid whose Bloodlust comes from another class is not scored as a missed cast.

defensives.name: Obsidian Scales
defensives.usage_rule: Press it ahead of a known damage spike, since it is your one large flat damage reduction.

defensives.name: Zephyr
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for raid-wide damage so it soaks the hit for nearby allies as well as you.

defensives.name: Cauterizing Flame
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to top yourself back up when chip damage has left you low between mechanics.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

rules.description: Open Dragonrage into Tip the Scales and Eternity Surge
rules.action: Lead with Dragonrage, then Tip the Scales off the global into Eternity Surge and a rank 1 Fire Breath.

rules.description: Save Eternity Surge and Fire Breath for Dragonrage
rules.action: Stop empowering as Dragonrage comes up and press both inside the window so Animosity extends it.
Hold it until Dragonrage is up, then spend it off the global on Eternity Surge.

rules.description: Keep the Fire Breath dot on your target
rules.action: Reapply rank 1 Fire Breath once the dot is at 30% duration or less, and remember spenders eat it through Consume Flame.

rules.description: Spend a Hover charge before each Deep Breath
rules.action: Burn a Hover charge before you take off so the Slipstream refund has room to land.

rules.description: Living Flame while Burnout is up
rules.action: Cash in Burnout on an instant Living Flame before you fall back to Azure Sweep or Azure Strike.

rules.description: Do not cap Essence Burst with Azure Sweep
rules.action: Dump Essence Burst into Disintegrate first, then press Azure Sweep to build it back.

rules.description: Pyre only at three or more targets
rules.action: Keep Pyre for 3 or more targets with Charged Blast stacked, and channel Disintegrate below that.

source_summary: Devastation is built around Dragonrage roughly every 2 minutes, with rank 1 Fire Breath and Eternity Surge held for the window so Animosity extends it and Tip the Scales spent off the global on an instant max rank Eternity Surge. Scalecommander adds Deep Breath on cooldown, cancelled on contact and preceded by a spent Hover charge for the Slipstream refund, while Flameshaper leans on Fire Breath dot uptime feeding Consume Flame. Everything between cooldowns is spending Essence and Essence Burst on Disintegrate or Pyre and filling with Living Flame, Azure Sweep, and Azure Strike.
